title: The hopper's match file
description: What the hopper (Milestone 3, slice 1) matches a visitor's font list against, in the browser: tff_catalog.owned.match_document, built by the site build from build/names.json, the catalog's ids and the reviewed recodes and names (owner rulings inventory_match_data_site_build of 2026-10-22, hopper_hackgen_related of 2026-10-23 and hopper_installed_names of 2026-10-28). Compact: one map from every known name's match_key to its codes. The schema gives the shape; Table.from_document, like the port's reader, also refuses an index out of range, a code-point range that runs down or names a surrogate, and words that are not printable ASCII.

run_date.description: The run of the names.json it was built from.

names_sha256.description: sha256 of that names.json's canonical JSON.

ids.description: The catalog's family ids, sorted; codes refer to them by index.

k.description: Every known name's match_key to its codes, comma-joined: <i> the family ids[i] itself, <i>r a rename, <i>p a PostScript name, <i>b a same-font build, <i>n a patched build, <i>u a bundle or package, <i>s a sibling, <i>x a related family (u, s and x are never owned, M3-D5), - a known family not in the catalog, !<j> an ineligible name with reasons[j].

amb.description: Ambiguous keys (a family's name that is also another family's weight, such as Archivo Black) to the indices of the catalog families their name may be a weight of. Every key is in k.

words.description: What candidates strips (tff_catalog.owned.WORDS). The port compiles its rules from this object; every word is printable ASCII.

separators.description: Single printable ASCII code points (hex) that may stand before a build suffix.

style.description: Style words: a whole word, or every camel-case part of one (BoldItalic).

modifiers.description: Stripped only with a style word after them (Extra Light).

postscript.description: Style words too after a PostScript hyphen (BoldIt).

abbreviations.description: Style abbreviations, stripped as whole words only (Kinto Sans Med).

variable.description: Variable-font words after a separator, in any ASCII case.

variable_joined.description: Variable-font words as written, right after a lower-case letter (InterVariable).

nerd.description: Nerd Fonts phrases, in any ASCII case, separators between their words optional.

nerd_tokens.description: Nerd Fonts tokens as written, after a separator, a lower-case letter or a digit.

cased.description: Build tokens as written, after a separator (CN, NL, PL).

codepoints.description: Hex code points or inclusive ranges, as in tests/vectors/name-keys.json.
